deck: Table Rock 909.33 ft. 4,016 cfs through the dam at 15:00 CT. Taneycomo still eats a pink worm if the generators give you a window.

play.title: Midge. Down. Slow.
play.body: Winter rainbows eat tiny and they eat on the pause. If you can't see your fly, you're fishing.

season.name: Winter trout
season.why: Table Rock gets quiet and vertical. Taneycomo becomes the reason you came. This is Johnny Morris water — cold, clear, and honest.
tips: Spoon or ice jig over 30–50 feet on Table Rock if you must. Most people shouldn't.
Taneycomo is the trip: midges, eggs, pink worms, tiny jigs, 2-pound test.
Generation still rules. A winter blowdown is a drift day.
Felt soles and a staff if you wad. The rocks don't care that you're on vacation.

tomorrow: Tomorrow we print a new USACE level, a new play, and whether the dam spun overnight. Open it before you drive. The water will have moved.

body: Table Rock sits at 909.33 ft this morning — a live USACE number, not a guess. Full pool is 915. Heat and a falling or hanging pool put bass on main-lake points, gravel, brush, and the first good humps in 15 to 35 feet. If you don't have electronics, you are guessing at bait.

Generation at the dam right now is 4,016 cfs (turbine 4,016). Overnight it backed off to about 20; the afternoon peak on this sheet hit 4,043. That pattern — quiet early, lean on it later — is the late-summer White River book.

taneycomo.dek: Cold tailwater · generation is the whole game

now.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.
now.generation: ~4,016 cfs at 15:00 CT (USACE live). Call SWPA 866-494-1993 before you wad.

body: Below Table Rock Dam this is a trout river that happens to be called a lake. The water comes out of the bottom cold and gin-clear. The generators decide whether you wade or drift.

Last printed reading: 4,016 cfs at 15:00 CT. We will not invent the next hour. Southwestern Power keeps the live sheet. The number is 866-494-1993. Call it in the parking lot. Off or near-off: pink Power Worm, wade, kids. Two-thousand-plus: dock or boat, fish the seams.
Light line — two to six pound. Rainbows are most of the creel. Slot in the upper water: put the 12-to-20-inch rainbows back. Don't horse them in this clarity. Don't wad a rising tailrace.
